scoped_evidence_replay.question_rule: Same affirmative front-crack predicate, optional image reference and determiner variation. No new source or model result.

critical_path.comparison: Frozen realized prompts, replies and service times in the two scored cohorts. With serial sends, their union is a lower bound even if all motion and local work vanish. Removing or regrouping requests can change both outputs and service. Do not extrapolate the bound to a changed controller.
critical_path.route_scope: One frozen ordinary call. For available options use the real returned demand after dispatch; this is an oracle diagnostic. Observed route time includes acquisition and verified return. An untraveled demanded alternative has unknown cost, at most one service window can be hidden. The separate nominal table uses pre-request trip estimates for unrealized routes. These are not whole-task effects.

matched_sparse_and_generic.interpretation: Frozen real pre-request camera candidates and costs. The full factored and generic algorithms use identical legal subsets and priors. At this point an in-flight image request cannot accept additional photos, so strong physical prefetch can enumerate the same feasible acquisitions. The oracle regret uses nominal trip costs and the subsequently realized model choice, never task time.

task_roster_on_fresh_camera.note: Initial onboard RGBs stored during the eight completed navigation resets. Candidate geometry requires a later live map check. No semantic answers, model-latency observations or full task success are claimed.

measured_range_result.interpretation: A scoped numerical range packet can show actual physical surfaces. Correct branch inference is untested, an absent hit does not establish a clear portal, and these fresh resets do not supply the old run's missing range scan.
